maria.s: Heads up — just noticed a BYOK import landed against tenant 'alpha-pay' and it has an operator-level entitlement. Audit shows a manual import event at 1761236800. Anyone triaging?
sec-bot: ALERT: HSM_IMPORT detected — key_id=hk_9f3a7c2b, method=manual-import, principal=ops:luca, source=onprem-import, audit_url=https://audit.internal/1761236800 
luca: Ugh — that was me. Ran an import on a lab host yesterday and I accidentally used PROD env var. Stopping now. Sorry.
devon.oncall: Ok — immediate actions: freeze operator entitlements for that key, snapshot the audit stream, and run a token/credential scan for alpha-pay. If anything looks cross-tenant we escalate.
maria.s: Agreed. Proposed checklist: 1) revoke operator entitlement on hk_9f3a7c2b 2) snapshot and archive audit logs (immutable) 3) scan for issued session tokens and decrypt ops 4) legal + CS hold if exposure. SRE, can you start the scans?
sre-oncall: On it. Running `./tools/kms-scan --tenant alpha-pay --since 2024-11-01 --output /tmp/scan-alpha-pay.json` now. Will also snapshot `/var/log/hsm/audit.log` to S3 with retention.
patrick.g: FYI if any customer data was encrypted with that key, policy SEC-3.4 says we trigger the customer-notify ladder. I'm opening SEC-4592 and pinging legal.
legal.j: Noted. Please do NOT notify customers yet — legal will review exposure and decide next steps. Keep me updated with artifacts.
luca: I revoked my operator role locally with `rbacctl revoke --principal ops:luca --key hk_9f3a7c2b`. Also capturing my workstation session logs and import commands.
sec-bot: AUDIT SNAPSHOT: no decrypt operations recorded against hk_9f3a7c2b in the last 7 days. Detected: two `sign` calls at 1761237000 and 1761237060 from svc-deploy (service account). Link: https://audit.internal/snapshots/1761237890
maria.s: svc-deploy sign calls are likely code-signing for nightly. Devon — can you confirm those are benign?
devon.oncall: Confirmed — svc-deploy signs artifacts (build pipeline) and keys used only for signing. No decrypts, no customer data access. Looks isolated to a mistaken import.
maria.s: Good. Closing immediate incident — follow-ups: A) add RBAC policy guard so manual BYOK imports cannot target prod tenants without explicit `--prod-import` flag and approval, B) add a pre-import env check in the import tool, C) postmortem assigned to luca.
luca: Will write the postmortem and PR for the import tool checks. Sorry again.
maria.s: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. Will update SEC-4592 with the final notes and close when PR merged.
